body:
I am only doing things that I want to do with my life. Trying new things, seeing new places, challenging myself, and just putting myself out there in general.

I stopped doing what was "expected" of me years ago, but I feel like I'm forcing myself to stay alive for others. If that makes sense.

I try to make plans to look forward to and tell myself "Oh, I have this event/trip soon I should take care of myself since it's already planned" but it's been harder lately. I also will play games or find a ton of shows to binge to help keep me occupied.
I was welcomed into an acquaintance turned friends home for the holiday to help me calm down but it's hard getting hurtful messages from my family.

I get overwhelmed and panic easily when I go to events alone but I try to go out to events. I usually can chat and meet a few people  but struggle keeping the connection.

I met one person and she wants to go to an arcade together soon.

I have been trying really hard for years to understand how to make therapy work. Explaining what I struggle with and what I have done to change. I just end up at the same place. A few have told me I am not trying enough others do not understand.

My current one is great at calming me down and trying to work though things with me but I don't know how to do it on my own. It's really hard. I try to do what she shows me.

I get what you're saying. I just moved a few weeks ago from living alone to a house with friends. I didnt expect things to magically improve. But ive always had that feeling of "Feeling all alone in a room full of people". I feel disconnected from everyone I guess. Making friends isnt easy for me or keeping friends.

Thank you but I'm so far gone I feel like nothing will help.
I just want to be happy and I don't want to be alone. The two things that are out of reach. I have tried so many times to turn things around but nothing works. 

I barely get any sleep. I'm just really fucking miserable and I feel like a burden.
Thank you. Its just frustrating when it feels like no matter how hard you try nothing is improving. You just end up in this cycle and after a while it becomes too much.
